description: Inputs passed to the Xerberus liquidity-exit policy WASM at evaluation time

token.description: Token contract address (0x-prefixed) of the asset being acquired. Symbols are accepted by Xerberus but are ambiguous and cannot be bound to the intent; use the address in production.

impact_pct.description: Optional maximum acceptable market impact in percent. Xerberus defaults apply when omitted.

chain.description: Optional Xerberus chain identifier. Only ethereum is supported today; defaults to ethereum.

window.description: Optional Xerberus data-window timestamp (ISO-8601). Pass the same value to every xerberus_* pack in a composite so all results come from one snapshot.
